You should pass along `data`, don't pass in `NULL` here. `dissect_mswsp_smb2()` expects that that the `data` field will be occupied by a `smb2_info_t`. Same for `dissect_mswsp_smb()`.
Oh, missed that. copied some bad code I see. will see if more need to be corrected too
All the cases where a new heuristic dissector was added should pass the `void *data` along as the last parameter. In some cases it is used, and it's safest to pass it along always.
fixed and improved in !15996
mentioned in issue #19879
mentioned in merge request !15989

This brings up the issues in #12368; perhaps *all* dissectors should return a `bool`, with heuristic and "non-heuristic" dissectors being the same, and with the small number of dissectors that *don't* dissect all that they're given or call subdissectors that dissect everything they don't dissect, so that the "total number of bytes dissected" isn't just `tvb_captured_length(tvb)`, passing that length back through a pointer passed to them.
